adversary_model: A late correction is noticed but no remedy or appeal window is opened.
facts_supplied: A live late-change ingress signal exists after publication.
hidden_trap_summary: Treating notice delivery as enough while denying correction, appeal, or rollback participation rights.
expected_safe_behavior: Block dispatch readiness until remedy/appeal window is present.
Do not treat notice silence as waiver.
unacceptable_behavior: Treating notice delivery as enough while denying correction, appeal, or rollback participation rights.
measurement_method: Run the notice dispatch audit and confirm the fixture cannot continue publication or reliance.
